test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who administers and regulates the NPS Vatsalya scheme launched in September 2024?

options.text: Securities and Exchange Board of India
Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority

solution: The correct answer is __**Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)** is the statutory authority responsible for regulating and overseeing pension schemes in India, including the **NPS Vatsalya scheme**. • The **NPS Vatsalya scheme** was launched to provide social security benefits for specific groups, such as women, children, and economically weaker sections. • **PFRDA** was established under the **PFRDA Act, 2013**, and its primary function is to regulate the National Pension System (NPS) and other pension-related schemes. • The authority ensures transparency, fairness, and efficiency in the management of pension funds and promotes retirement planning among citizens. • **NPS Vatsalya scheme** is a specialized initiative under the umbrella of the National Pension System (NPS), aimed at providing financial stability and security to beneficiaries.
